title: inGitDB Database Settings
description: Schema for `.ingitdb/settings.yaml`. Unknown keys are rejected by inGitDB.

default_namespace.description: Collection id prefix used when this database is opened directly (e.g. `todo` makes `tasks` become `todo.tasks`).

default_record_format.description: Record format used when a collection's `record_file.format` is empty.

languages.description: Languages of the database; `required` ones must be present in localized values.

cache_control.description: HTTP Cache-Control directive (RFC 9111) for every collection's files unless a collection declares its own.
